# er605_list_item (Resource)

One row of a router list form. Existence is tracked; field drift is not (write and read shapes differ on some forms).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) e.g. /admin/nat?form=vs
- `item` (String) jsonencode({...}) row body exactly as the web UI submits it.
- `key_field` (String) Field in item that uniquely identifies the row (e.g. name, mac).

### Optional

- `read_key_field` (String) Field the read form uses for the key when it differs from key_field (e.g. ipaddr -> ip). Defaults to key_field.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
